== Biography ==
Andrew Glasgow was born on 27 March 1790 and baptised on 11 April 1790 at Bathgate, Linlithgowshire, Scotland. The parish transcript names Peter Glasgow and Elisabeth Dick as his parents.<ref name="FMP">"Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929," Findmypast transcript, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4121897&tab=this Andrew Glasgow, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/4121897] (accessed 23 October 2026), birth 27 March 1790, baptism 11 April 1790, Bathgate, parents Peter Glasgow and Elisabeth Dick. Original register image not inspected.</ref> They are represented on this profile by [[Glasgow-1466|Peter Glasgow]] and [[Dick-6841|Elizabeth Dick]]; the identification of the recorded father with the selected Peter profile remains probable rather than proved. The baptism locality does not separately prove Andrew's exact birthplace.
